address: 2F, Roppongi Hills Hillside, 6-10-1 Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, 106-0032, Japan
bio: Red and black are the thematic colours of L’ATELIER de Joël Robuchon. The classic Robuchon menu spins a tale like a 19th-century French novel. The menu ranges from famous specialities of years gone by to new arrangements incorporating seasonal Japanese ingredients. This really is ‘Joël Robuchon’s atelier’, where the genius honed his concept of French gastronomy....
